text: 7月24日，沪深两市全天成交额合计19311.40亿元。其中，沪市成交额为9153.66亿元；深市成交额为10157.74亿元；创业板成交额为4492.92亿元。
text_en: On July 24, the total turnover of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets was 1931.14 billion yuan. Among them, the Shanghai market turnover was 915.366 billion yuan; the Shenzhen market turnover was 1015.774 billion yuan; and the ChiNext market turnover was 449.292 billion yuan.
